summary.text: Dade Phelan is the State Representative for Texas House District 21, of Beaumont, serving his fifth term, and is the 76th Speaker of the Texas House. His official biography says he previously chaired the House Committee on State Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Phelan was born and raised in Southeast Texas and received a bachelor's degree in Government and Business from the University of Texas at Austin.
He works as a real estate developer at his family's fourth-generation commercial real estate development firm.
He is the former president of the Lower Neches Valley Authority, to which the Governor appointed him twice.
Texas Monthly named him one of the Best Legislators of the 86th legislative session in 2019.
His wife, Kim, is an attorney, and they have four sons.
